citations.C1: Missing key ('price'/'qty' absent) raises KeyError uncaught
citations.C2: None values (null CSV cell parsed as None) raise TypeError
citations.C4: Thousands separators ("1,200.50") raise ValueError → strip commas or use locale-aware parser
citations.C5: qty as float string ("2.0") raises ValueError on int()
citations.C6: Binary float arithmetic drifts (0.1+0.2 rounding) over many rows → use Decimal for money, not float
citations.C7: Negative price or qty silently subtracts from total
citations.C8: float() accepts "inf"/"nan" → total becomes inf/nan silently
